gloss: to be replaced; to be swapped out

definitions.gloss: to be replaced; to be swapped out
definitions.explanation: For one thing to take the place of another. The intransitive counterpart of {置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace); the new item that takes over is marked with に.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}わる。
examples.english: The old machines are being replaced with new ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{置|お}き{換|か}わった。
examples.english: The data was swapped out automatically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}わりつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Paper documents are gradually being replaced by electronic data.

notes:
The intransitive counterpart of ⟦{置|お}き{換|か}える→置き換える：08226_okikaeru⟧ (to replace something). What the subject denotes is superseded by, or takes the place of, something else, which is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive: A ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ B ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}わる (A is replaced by B)
- Transitive pair: ⟦{置|お}き{換|か}える→置き換える：08226_okikaeru⟧ (to replace A with B)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}わる: to be replaced automatically
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}き{換|か}わる: to be gradually replaced
